learning_objective: 🎯 Let us join Chanda Mama on a fun counting adventure high up in the night sky!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Chanda Mama, our friendly moon, looks at all his little star friends and decides he wants to count them all.
He starts counting one, two, three, but there are just too many! Some naughty stars even play hide and seek behind the clouds.
He realizes you cannot count all the stars because the sky is so big. Instead, we can just enjoy their beautiful shiny light!

fun_activity.title: 🔢 Star Counter
fun_activity.instructions: Take a black piece of paper and put small dots of white paint on it to make a galaxy. Now try to count how many stars you made!

quick_recap: ⭐ Chanda Mama tries to count all the twinkling stars in the sky.
⭐ There are so many stars that it is impossible to count every single one.
⭐ The stars love to play fun games like hide and seek in the dark.
